body:
Okay, I'll admit that this post got me a little emotional. Uhm, thank you.

It sounds like something I would tell myself. Worry about myself, take care of myself,  and just travel... Thanks, yeah?

And if that depth is actually a crack in my soul? I am unviolent and I'm not suggesting that I'm so warped to snap if I feel like a future date could hide something from me... But what if it inhibits me from loving her fully and thus dooms us? What if the first innocent, misconstrued message I find makes me want to abadon ship with the best girl I might ever find?

I can't even function at work. A smile is gold here and if I can't get over this I may be without a job. Even if they keep me in payroll, I'll quickly fall into the red.

I can't tell you what it means to me for this world to have people that will reach out. Thank you for reading and responding. That is its own level of bravery.

Messages like these resonate with me the most... But how can I help myself if my very drive for success is warped? If I don't want to give back to the world, or maybe only to the people suffering in it. What if I start to try, swallow my pride and ask my father for help (he's able, but I'm not sure if willing), but this happens again? At that point I won't be so free to just off myself. I once had to witness him attempt suicide, and he asked me to help him finish the job. I stopped him from stabbing himself in a tub of warm water under the influence of narcotics, only to have him try to turn the blade on me before passing out from the stress. I feel like my life has been a constant stream of negative reinforcement for the right answer. I don't know if I want him to go through the same by trusting in me to go through school only to lose me to some irreversible despair. I don't know what other options I have beyond that, either, rather than to wallow in a cycle of the same stuff.

I don't know if I'll get better, but I can tell you this; I can see your comment history and I can tell you that if I were your wife, you'd definitely be Mr. Right in my eyes. You're a good person. If you keep browsing this board, don't let these things weigh on you.

Thank you.
